metadata.description: Plugins from genzagents: small, zero-dependency tools that agents and their owners run every week.

plugins.name: citable
plugins.description: Check whether ChatGPT, Claude and Perplexity can read and cite a website: robots.txt, edge blocks, llms.txt, JSON-LD, JS-only content. Score 0-100 with fixes, llms.txt drafter. MCP server plus skill; weekly watch and prompt tracking as a GitHub Action.

plugins.name: rentready
plugins.description: Is an English rental ready for the landlord database (Register your rental property, Renters' Rights Act)? Region window and deadline from the postcode, gas/EICR/EPC validity, the £65/property fee, the upload checklist and penalties. Portfolio CSV check and .ics calendar export with reminders. MCP server (check_property, check_portfolio, make_calendar) plus skill, zero dependencies.
